about: Patterns on the Vedic grid 3 1 9 / 6 7 5 / 2 8 4. A yoga forms when every digit in `present` is in the number and every digit in `absent` is not (red X on the slide). Blank cells on the slide are ignored. The same rules are applied to the mobile grid and, separately, to the birth-date grid.

rules.name: Easy Money Yoga
rules.quote: EASY MONEY YOGA — MONEY WITH LUCK, Intelligent

story.good: Easy Money Yoga: money comes to you with luck. You are intelligent, a good writer and speaker (astrology and journalism suit you too), with an attractive look. Relationships, with friends and affairs alike, come easily, and people appreciate your work.

rules.name: Don't Want to Marry
rules.quote: DON'T WANT TO MARRY — RISE OF DESTINY AFTER MARRIAGE

story.good: Your destiny rises after marriage. You have a good social life and are highly generous, clever and well educated, with social and religious thoughts.
story.trait: You follow your own rules and regulations.
story.care: You may not want to marry.

rules.name: Sun Jupiter
rules.quote: SUN JUPITER — WISE, LEARNED, WISDOM, LEADER, ASTROLOGER

story.good: Wise, learned and a leader, with respect, reputation, education and intelligence. A combination for leaders, doctors, judges and astrologers (and for yoga). You achieve success by your own strength.

rules.name: Sun Mars
rules.quote: SUN MARS — HIGH EDUCATION, AGGRESSIVE, SHORT-TEMPERED

story.good: High education and self-confidence. A combination for leaders, surgeons, engineers and ministers, and fire-related work is good for you.
story.care: Can make you aggressive and short-tempered.

rules.name: Sun Ketu
rules.quote: SUN KETU — SUN IS ROD AND KETU IS FLAG, WHEN THEY MEET THEY FLY HIGH

story.good: The Sun is the rod and Ketu the flag, and when they meet they fly high. A combination for government jobs and the mystical sciences, bringing respect, name, fame and wealth.
story.care: Can bring dual marital relations, less domestic happiness and misunderstandings with your father.

rules.name: Venus Moon
rules.quote: VENUS MOON — VERY CREATIVE AND ATTRACTIVE

story.good: Very creative and attractive, a lover of art and music.
story.care: Can make you prone to affairs, possibly with two marriages, and willing to do anything for luxury. May bring hindrance in education and a chance of diabetes or urinary diseases.

rules.name: Ketu Saturn
rules.quote: KETU SATURN — MISS-FORTUNE [ LIFE, PARENTS, ACCIDENT, MARRIAGE]

story.care: Can bring misfortune in matters of life, parents, accidents and marriage, a pessimistic nature, family disturbance and a lack of good sexual life.

rules.name: Saturn Rahu
rules.quote: SATURN RAHU — ONLY PLANNING NO EXECUTION

story.care: Only planning, no execution. Accident-prone, imaginary, with chronic disease, bad habits and a lack of sexual life. Thorny trees nearby are linked with this yoga.

rules.name: Mercury Rahu
rules.quote: MERCURY RAHU — BANDHAN YOG

story.good: Intelligent, wise and clever.
story.trait: You need continuous change in life.
story.care: Forms Bandhan Yog, which can bring loss in government work, weak eyesight, disease and litigation (your own or others').

rules.name: Mars Mercury (Intelligent Yoga)
rules.quote: MARS MERCURY — INTELLIGENT YOGA

story.good: Intelligent Yoga: you are physically active, and business suits you.
story.care: You may speak in a bitter manner and sometimes disturb your own work.

rules.name: Moon Saturn (Depression Yoga)
rules.quote: MOON SATURN — DEPRESSION YOGA

story.care: Depression Yoga: feelings of fear and negative thoughts. Linked with leakage in the house, and with being away from water.
story.trait: Two sisters of the same family may marry into the same family.

rules.name: Venus Ketu
rules.quote: VENUS KETU — ART AND MUSIC LOVER, Gets luxury

story.good: A lover of art and music who gets luxury, and spiritual too.
story.care: Can bring more than one affair or a second marriage.

multiples.care: With more than one 6, there can be continuous fights.

multiples.quote: MULTIPLE 7 INCREAS IN INSTABILITY AND ATTRACTION BOTH
multiples.care: With more than one 7, both instability and attraction increase.

rules.name: Sun Saturn
rules.quote: SUN SATURN — OBSTACLES, DISRESPECT

story.care: Can bring obstacles and disrespect, loss of a government job, family disturbances, health issues for your father, and differences with your father or boss.

rules.name: Moon Rahu
rules.quote: MOON RAHU — WEAK EYESIGHT AND MENTAL DISEASES

story.care: Linked with weak eyesight and mental illness, an inferiority complex, family struggle, possible eye and heart problems, more anxiety, worry and fear, and unrealistic expectations.

rules.name: Mars Rahu
rules.quote: MARS RAHU — STRONG BANDHAN YOG

story.good: Suits lawyers, doctors and the police, and money comes through hard work.
story.care: A strong Bandhan Yog: mental disturbance, court or hospital matters, restlessness and risk-taking.

remedy.text: Take your food in the kitchen.

rules.name: Jupiter Mars
rules.quote: JUPITER MARS — MORE WORK LESS GAINS

story.good: A combination of doctor and leader. Meditation Yog and pilgrimages; intelligent and learned, with wisdom.
story.care: More work, less gains.

rules.name: Venus Mercury
rules.quote: VENUS MERCURY — HIGHER EDUCATION, HURDLES

story.good: Higher education and a very creative, artistic mind, like authors, musicians, actors and writers. Points to love marriage.
story.care: Hurdles, and family conflict.
story.trait: A flour mill nearby is linked with this yoga.

rules.name: Jupiter Moon
rules.quote: JUPITER MOON — DISTURBANCE IN EDUCATION

story.good: Gaj Kesari Yog and creativity. You may have many enemies, but they cannot harm you.
story.care: Disturbance in education, ego and arrogance, and less happiness from children.
story.trait: Lemon trees nearby are linked with this yoga.

rules.name: Saturn Mercury
rules.quote: SATURN MERCURY — SHARP MEMORY, MANAGEMENT, GOOD FINANCE

story.good: Sharp memory, management and good finance; finance and insurance-related work. Bhagyodaya after 35 years.
story.care: Can make you selfish, is inauspicious for your father, and may bring skin problems.

rules.name: Sun Moon (4th aspect)
rules.quote: SUN MOON (4th Aspect) — Ek baar life me zero face karenge

story.care: You may face a 'zero' once in life. Can bring hidden enemies, debts and health issues, possible family disturbance, and ups and downs.

rules.name: Sun Rahu (4th aspect)
rules.quote: SUN RAHU (4th Aspect) — PITRA DOSHA, Notice of Income Tax, Health issue, Debt issue

story.care: Pitra dosha: income-tax notices, health and debt issues, marriage issues, physical or financial problems, and child-birth issues, especially if Rahu is in the 5th or 9th house of the birth chart.

remedy.quote: STRENGTHEN SUN, RAHU MANI & JAAP, SERVE CROWS, AMAVASYA REMEDY, DO SEVA IN OLD AGE HOME OR ELDERS OF FAMILY
remedy.text: Strengthen the Sun; do Rahu mani and jaap; serve crows; do the Amavasya remedy; and do seva in an old-age home or for the elders of your family.

rules.name: Jupiter Saturn (4th aspect)
rules.quote: JUPITER SATURN (4th Aspecct) — DHARAMKARAMADHIPATI YOGA

story.good: Dharmakarmadhipati Yoga: you achieve your goals after struggle. A good advisor and counsellor, you can be a judge or astrologer.

rules.name: Jupiter Mercury (4th aspect)
rules.quote: JUPITER MERCURY (4th Aspect) — Sharp memory

story.good: Sharp memory, and good for studies abroad.
story.care: A lack of money even in good economic conditions. Your native place is not favourable, so you do better away from it, and your father-in-law may have breathing problems.

rules.name: Mars Saturn (4th aspect)
rules.quote: MARS SATURN (4th Aspect) — EARTHQUAKE YOGA

story.good: You can be a good advocate, engineer or doctor.
story.care: Earthquake Yoga: an argumentative nature, ups and downs in life, and differences with your brother.

rules.name: Moon Mercury (4th aspect)
rules.quote: MOON MERCURY (4th Aspect) — Sharp memory, International tours

story.good: Sharp memory and international tours; occult science, astrology and tantra.
story.care: Urine and bone issues, and possible involvement in a financial scam.

rules.name: Venus Rahu (4th aspect)
rules.quote: VENUS RAHU (4th Aspect) — Urinary infection, Sexual problem, Skin disease

story.care: Linked with urinary infection, sexual problems, skin disease, piles and sperm issues, a casanova nature, a possibly criminal mind, and problems in love life.

rules.name: Venus Mars (4th aspect)
rules.quote: VENUS MARS (4th Aspect) — Love marriage

story.good: Love marriage, and you are a good planner.
story.care: Differences with your brother because of your wife, and affairs with other women. Marrying late is suggested, otherwise disputes may arise.

rules.name: Venus Mars Rahu
rules.quote: VENUS MARS RAHU — Connected with crimes

story.care: Connected with crimes and uncordial relations; two marriages, relationships and affairs.

rules.review_note: The slide's example (Kiran Bedi) is not shown on the site.

rules.name: Sun Moon Rahu
rules.quote: SUN MOON RAHU — Connected with crimes

story.care: Connected with crimes; debts, diseases and enemies; family disturbances and ups and downs; obstruction in government work; and either no sister or differences with her.

rules.name: Jupiter Moon Mercury
rules.quote: JUPITER MOON MERCURY — Sharp mind, Foreign travel

story.good: A sharp mind and foreign travel.
story.care: Financial scams and shortcut methods, and less happiness from your own property. Staying away from your native place helps you progress.

rules.name: Jupiter Mars Saturn
rules.quote: JUPITER MARS SATURN — HURDLES IN EDUCATION, FAMILY ISSUES

story.good: You can be a judge or lawyer.
story.care: Hurdles in education, family issues, either no brother or differences with him, an argumentative nature, and possible disturbance in the family.

rules.name: Jupiter Sun Mars
rules.quote: JUPITER SUN MARS — STRONG PERSONALITY, AGGRESSIVE

story.good: A strong, courageous personality, educated and respected, and a sports-person.
story.care: Can make you aggressive, and brings delay in marriage.

rules.name: Venus Ketu Mercury (Raj Yog)
rules.quote: VENUS KETU MERCURY (RAJ YOG) — ULTRA LUXURIOUS

story.good: Raj Yog: an ultra-luxurious life, a big house, family growth and a high level of living. A lover of music and art, a good speaker and writer, with love and romance, and a good businessman.

rules.name: Mars Mercury Rahu
rules.quote: MARS MERCURY RAHU — QUICK DECISION AND ACTIONS

story.good: Quick decisions and actions; a multitasker.
story.care: Jack of all trades, master of none; outspoken; property disputes.

rules.name: Jupiter Venus Moon
rules.quote: JUPITER VENUS MOON — DON'T WANT TO MARRY, RISE OF DESTINY AFTER MARRIAGE

story.good: Your destiny rises after marriage. You are attractive, a music lover, with good education.
story.care: You may not want to marry. Problems related to gynae, or lack of sperm. Staying away from your native place is suggested.

rules.name: Moon Saturn Rahu
rules.quote: MOON SATURN RAHU — AWAY FROM BIRTHPLACE, MAJOR UP'S AND DOWN'S LIFE

story.care: Away from your birthplace, with major ups and downs in life. No control over speech when aggressive. Chances of death by accident. Negative thoughts, addiction and chronic disease.

rules.review_note: The slide's example (Rajiv Gandhi, 20/8/1944) is not shown on the site; it is used as a test.

rules.name: Sun Ketu Saturn
rules.quote: SUN KETU SATURN — STRONG INTUTION POWER, BLACK TOUNGE

story.good: Strong intuition power, knowledge of technical work and more than one source of income. You may be a social worker, politician or philanthropist.
story.care: A black tongue. You are helpful but don't get the same in return.

rules.name: Jupiter Ketu Rahu (Kaal Sarp Dosh Yoga)
rules.quote: JUPITER KETU RAHU (KAAL SHARP DOSH YOGA) — SUCCESSIVE KAAL SHARP DOSHA YOGA

story.good: You can reach a top position.
story.care: Kaal Sarp Dosh Yoga: hurdles in education. Don't be proud or arrogant about your success.

rules.name: Moon Ketu Mars (Kaal Sarp Dosh Yoga)
rules.quote: MOON KETU MARS (KAAL SHARP DOSH YOGA) — STRUGGLED LIFE, AWAY FROM FAMILY

story.good: Courageous.
story.care: Kaal Sarp Dosh Yoga: a life of struggle, away from family, with family disturbance, joint pains and urinary diseases.

rules.name: Sun Mars Ketu
rules.quote: SUN MARS KETU — MARRIAGE DELAY, INTERCASTE MARRIAGE

story.good: Fortunate, with foreign travel.
story.care: Delay in marriage (a late marriage) and Manglik.

rules.name: Sun Ketu Mercury
rules.quote: SUN KETU MERCURY — Sharp mind and high Level Thoughts

story.good: A sharp mind with high-level thoughts, logical-minded, suiting a teacher or astrologer.

rules.name: Sun Ketu Venus
rules.quote: SUN KETU VENUS — Music Lover / Luxury Life Style

story.good: A music lover with a luxurious lifestyle.
story.care: More than one love affair and marriage, with ups and downs.

rules.name: Jupiter Sun Ketu
rules.quote: JUPITER SUN KETU — Govt. Job / Abroad Tours

story.good: A government job and tours abroad. You can be a teacher, judge, advocate or astrologer, educated and respected.

rules.name: Ketu Mercury Rahu (Bondage Yoga)
rules.quote: KETU MERCURY RAHU — Debt Related issues and Defamation

story.care: Bondage Yoga: debt-related issues and defamation, and a life of struggle.

rules.name: Mercury Rahu Saturn (Bondage Yoga)
rules.quote: MERCURY RAHU SATURN — Addiction / Bondage Yoga

story.care: Bondage Yoga: addiction, a possible lack of sexual life, and fear of loss.

rules.name: Venus Moon Saturn
rules.quote: VENUS MOON SATURN — Family Trouble due to Opposite Sex

story.good: You have good money.
story.care: Family trouble because of the opposite sex, obstruction in education, and obstacles.

rules.name: Sun Venus Saturn Mercury (Raj Yog)
rules.quote: SUN VENUS SATURN MERCURY (RAJ YOG) — INTELLIGENT AND COURAGEOUS

story.good: Raj Yog: intelligent, courageous and flexible, with name and fame in your country and abroad.

rules.review_note: The slide's example (Sania Mirza) is not shown on the site; her birth date is used as a test.
